svg.title: Launch Approved Campaign UML Sequence Diagram
svg.desc: UML sequence diagram for launching an approved campaign in the Bayer-Westphalian Campaign Management Platform.
svg.text: Bayer-Westphalian Campaign Management Platform — UML Sequence Diagram
Load campaign from PostgreSQL by campaignId
Check consent, opt-out, do-not-contact, guardian consent
Check duplicate contact, monthly contact limit, uninterested status,
Campaign history and customer status data
Insert eligible and excluded recipient records
Record sent and failed contact events
Update campaign status to ACTIVE or COMPLETED
Read campaign recipient and contact event data
Audience, eligibility, delivery, and engagement data
